title: Super League Soccer | Taunts Unlocked
features:
⚽ Free Taunt Selector

This script gives you free access to taunts and lets you equip them directly into any of your four taunt slots! 🔥

Instead of needing to manually unlock or equip each taunt through the normal interface, simply select the taunt you want, choose a slot, and equip it! 🆓

✨ Features

- 🆓 Free Taunts — Access and equip the taunts available in the selector.
- ⚽ 36 Taunts — Includes all 36 provided taunts.
- 🖼️ Taunt Icons — Each taunt's icon is displayed above its name.
- ⬜ Individual Cards — Every taunt has its own white-outlined card.
- 🎒 Loadout Detection — Automatically reads your current EquippedTaunts.
- 1️⃣ 4 Taunt Slots — Manage Slot 1, Slot 2, Slot 3, and Slot 4.
- 🖱️ Easy Equipping — Select a taunt → click a slot → equipped!
- 🔄 Individual Slot Editing — Only the slot you select gets changed.
- 🔒 Loadout Protection — Attempts to restore your selected taunts if EquippedTaunts changes afterward.
- ✅ Success Notifications — Shows when a taunt is successfully equipped.
- ❌ Error Notifications — Alerts you when something goes wrong.
- 🔔 Selection Notifications — Shows which taunt you've selected.
- 🎨 Black UI — Clean black-themed interface.
- 🔲 Rounded Corners — Smooth UI styling throughout.
- ✨ Hover Animations — Taunt cards react when you hover over them.
- 💡 Selection Highlighting — Your selected taunt stays brighter than hovered taunts.
- 🖱️ Full UI Hover Effect — The entire interface reacts when hovered.
- ✋ Draggable UI — Move the interface anywhere on your screen.
- ❎ Close Button — Click X to hide the interface.
- ⌨️ X Keybind — Press X to hide/show the interface.
- 🛡️ Executor UI Support — Uses gethui() and GUI protection functions when available.
- 🔌 Broad Executor Compatibility — Designed to work across many executors by falling back to PlayerGui if executor-specific GUI functions are unavailable.
- ⚠️ Not Guaranteed on Every Executor — Some executors may handle gethui(), CoreGui, OnTopOfCoreBlur, or GUI protection differently.
- 🧹 Duplicate Protection — Automatically removes older copies when re-executed.
- 🚫 Missing Icon Support — Displays NO IMAGE when a taunt doesn't have an icon.

🔥 What Does It Do?

The script acts as a free taunt selector and custom loadout manager.

It reads your current four equipped taunts, displays them in the UI, and allows you to select another taunt and assign it to whichever slot you want.

🆓 Select. Equip. Taunt.
